A smart note-taking app for students

NoteSpark keeps all your class notes in one place. You can type a note, scan a textbook page, handout or whiteboard with the camera, or write by hand on the screen, and NoteSpark turns it into text you can edit. Notes are organized by course and can be searched and pinned. Google ML Kit then helps you study: it finds the deadlines in your notes, translates notes to English and summarizes long notes. Your notes are saved in the cloud with Firebase Cloud Firestore, in a private account for your phone, and they stay available offline. The ML Kit features run on your device, so your notes are never sent to them and they work offline once the models are downloaded.

string-array.name: about_features
string-array.item: Scan notes: the ML Kit Document Scanner and Text Recognition turn a page into text
Handwriting to text: write with a finger or stylus, converted by Digital Ink Recognition
Upcoming deadlines: Entity Extraction finds the dates and times in your notes, and one tap adds them to your calendar
Translate notes: Language Identification and Translation turn a note into English
Summarize notes: Gemini Nano writes a short summary on supported phones
Organize: sort notes by course, search them and pin the important ones
Cloud storage: notes are saved in Firebase Cloud Firestore under a private anonymous account, and keep working offline

string-array.name: about_how_to
string-array.item: Tap New note, then give the note a title and a course
Type your note, or tap Scan or Handwrite to add text
Tap Summarize, Translate or Find dates to work on the note
Tap the check mark or go back to save
On the main screen, search, filter by course or pin a note
Tap the calendar icon to see your upcoming deadlines
